description: Single-entry JSON contract for dislop-ai/awesome-anti-slop (data/entries/<id>.json). Backward-compatible evolution of dislop.radar/2.

entryExample.name: blader/humanizer
entryExample.summaryEn: English prose revision skill grounded in Wikipedia Signs of AI Writing, supporting author style samples for voice calibration.
entryExample.summaryZh: 基于 WP:AISIGNS 的英语改写技能，支持导入作者样稿做语感校准。

selfListingExample.name: dislop-ai/dislop
selfListingExample.summaryEn: Zero-dependency deterministic deliverable linter and revision fact-verifier for Markdown, HTML/CSS/SVG, DOCX, PPTX, and PDF.
selfListingExample.summaryZh: 零依赖确定性交付物印前审校与改稿标记复检工具，覆盖中英双语文稿、前端/SVG 与 Office/PDF 结构检查。

neutralityConstraints: No subjective comparison field against dislop or any specific vendor.
summaryEn <= 160 chars; summaryZh <= 90 CJK chars; factual mechanism description only.
Tools focused on detector evasion or watermark removal must set section='contrast-and-detection' and status='contrast-watch'.
Only entries with kind='software' transition to status='stale' after 18 months without default-branch commits; skill-doc and research-policy use 'historical-baseline'.
